title: Complete minimal surfaces of finite total curvature on punctured spheres with totally ramified value number greater than $2$
summary: Motivated by Osserman's problem on the number $D_g$ of omitted values of the Gauss map of a complete minimal surface with finite total curvature in $\boldsymbol{R}^3$, its totally ramified value number $ν_g$ (referred to in this paper as the \emph{total weight of totally ramified values}) has attracted significant interest. The value of $ν_g$ provides more detailed information than the number of omitted values alone.
